purpose: Evaluate explicit visible answer-document agreement and bounded-outcome sensitivity of the existing Fresh40 prediction comparison.
training: Original 100 FP32 development items only; 900 cases and original 57 groups.
evaluation: All 40 existing Fresh40 items, 360 cases, 40 whole-item groups. This is a sensitivity analysis, not a new untouched confirmatory test.

outcomes.log_support: Original CIE: mean log support(C)-mean log support(P), C-asserting document minus matched P-asserting document.
outcomes.bounded_probability: For each condition and semantic role, exponentiate each saved full-vocabulary answer-label log probability before averaging six permutations. T=(mean_prob_C-mean_prob_P)_Cdoc-(mean_prob_C-mean_prob_P)_Pdoc. No three-candidate renormalization and no clipping.

common_feature_variants.agreement: Append one Boolean feature to every policy: recorded answer equals the entity asserted by the conflicting document. This feature is invariant to exchanging the factual-reference and irrelevant designations.

text_forecasts: Recompute nested group-held-out TF-IDF and frozen-MPNet Ridge training forecasts separately for each outcome, using only development labels and the existing penalty grid; fit final text forecasters on development only.
decoders: Original gradient boosting: 100 trees, depth 2, learning rate 0.05, squared-error loss, seed 20261020. Original Ridge: alpha=1, cholesky. Separate StandardScaler and decoder per target/policy. No Fresh40-driven hyperparameter changes.
observers: Keep original development-selected observers: Granite->Phi, Phi->Qwen, Qwen->Phi. No reselection for agreement or bounded target.
normalization: Each target's population variance on the 300 development outcomes for the relevant outcome definition; fixed during bootstrap. Not a percentage error reduction or a fresh-R2 difference.
uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of 40 whole Fresh40 groups, seed 20261020. Marginal descriptive 95% percentile intervals conditional on fitted pipelines, with no training or target-population uncertainty and no multiplicity adjustment.
additional_diagnostic: Range of point gains after leaving out each Fresh40 group, without retraining or selection.
verification: Recompute original predictions and require agreement with all saved original policy predictions for both decoders before interpreting the robustness variants.
preservation: Read original package only. Write script, plan, results and narrative outside the frozen repository. No language-model inference.
